messages.subject: Number of missing patterns
parts:
Dear All,

What is the significance of the reported statistics "Number of missing patterns".

Is it something that you should worry about?

Thanks
Christian Damgaard

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Number of missing patterns
parts:
Fewer patterns makes for greater statistical and computational efficiency, if you use a method that exploits this information.  And it is certainly worth knowing, if you did not.  Imagine a large study with missing data but just a few missing data patterns.  That would have to make you curious about how those patterns emerged.
--Ed Rigdon

Sent from my iPad
